exposure: reduced foetal movement in the 2 weeks prior to delivery
Reduced foetal movement in the 2 weeks prior to delivery
cohort: Women with hospital-based deliveries at a secondary level hospital in Melbourne, Australia
finding: Previous caesarean section, pregnancy while being unmarried, higher haemoglobin level and reduced foetal movement in the 2 weeks before delivery were significant predictors of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was a significant predictor of stillbirth.
